summary: Comprehensive testing of Sistema de Lotería RD/USA. Backend: 25/25 tests passed. Frontend: 22/23 pages working. One bug found in Favorites page (fixed). Critical APIs all working.

minor.issue: Was failing with KeyError: 'amount' for multi-play tickets that use 'total_amount'. FIXED by using .get() with fallback.

ui_bugs.issue: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map') - Favorites page crashes because data model changed from item.numbers to item.plays array
ui_bugs.status: PARTIALLY_FIXED - Code updated but may need frontend restart to take effect

action_items: Verify Favorites page fix is applied after frontend restart
Consider adding more data validation on frontend for API responses with varying structures
critical_code_review_comments: favorites.tsx: Interface mismatch - Favorites API returns 'plays' array but frontend expected 'numbers' array. Fixed by adding getAllNumbers() helper function
server.py line 2307: Sellers report was using t['amount'] but multi-play tickets use 'total_amount'. Fixed with .get() fallback
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features working. Favorites page had a data model mismatch that was fixed - the API returns 'plays' array instead of 'numbers' directly. Backend sellers-report endpoint was fixed for multi-play tickets.
